value.answer: For short-term use most people seem fine with it. The NIH says it appears safe for most people, and UC Davis says it's typically well tolerated at low doses when taken for the shortest time. Long-term is less clear. A heart failure link showed up in a preliminary AHA conference abstract from November 2025, but it can't prove cause and effect, and some experts think poor sleep may be behind it. Sources also disagree on dose and how long to use it, so if you're thinking of taking it regularly, check with a doctor or pharmacist first, especially if you take other medicines.
